Major clients include SFR, TotalEnergies, Weight Watchers, La Française des Jeux and Recommerce. The group runs its own WMS, ERP and TMS software with real-time tracking and a call center handling 3,000 calls per day. Combined with D-Groupe, the entity generates 100 million euro in revenue with 600 staff.

saude.mt.gov.br The Secretaria de Estado de Saúde de Mato Grosso is the state health department of Mato Grosso, Brazil, responsible for public healthcare across 141 municipalities and 3.6 million inhabitants. Headquartered in Cuiabá under Secretary Renata Aparecida Barbirato, it manages state hospitals, laboratories, blood centers and the AFFARMES free medication program. Its network includes the Julio Müller General Hospital, the Tropical Diseases Hospital, the Maternal-Infant Hospital, UPA emergency units and the LACEN state laboratory. In 2026 it launched new water quality monitoring programs and updated its vaccination calendar including COVID-19 and tropical disease campaigns. The department runs an open procurement portal for medical equipment and pharmaceuticals with a budget of approximately 4 to 5 billion reais. Digital transformation initiatives include electronic health records, the SEI-MT document system and integration with Brazil's national health data network.

fivestarplating.com Five Star Plating LLC is an American electroplating and metal finishing company founded in 2007 in Little Rock, Arkansas, with 82 employees and approximately 12.5 million dollars in annual revenue. It operates 3 automatic plating lines plus 1 manual rack line across two facilities, coating around 50 million parts per year. Its core offerings include zinc and zinc alloy plating, phosphate coatings, E-Coat electrocoating and specialty finishes like zinc-nickel as a cadmium replacement for aerospace and defense. The company serves automotive, oil and gas, construction, aerospace and military clients with ISO 9001 certification and salt spray testing capabilities up to 1,000 hours. Key strengths are full-spectrum plating from mass barrel to custom rack work, a dedicated testing laboratory and strategic location in central Arkansas. It is the largest specialized plater in the state with continued growth of 16 percent year over year.

bsfgroup.co.uk Barkingshopfronts Limited is a London-based shop front manufacturer and installer founded in 2018 in Barking, specializing in aluminium, frameless glass and timber shop fronts, roller shutters, canopies and structural steel for retail, restaurants and offices. With around 20 to 30 staff and estimated revenue of 1 to 5 million pounds, it runs its own production facility on Movers Lane in East London. Its unique Sit-and-Go Shops product offers fully fitted ready-to-open retail spaces from frontage to interior fixtures. The company has delivered projects across all London boroughs including a flagship aluminium frontage for a Mayfair espresso bar and international work in Romania. Services span design, manufacturing, installation and maintenance of shop fronts, bi-fold doors, automatic doors, fire exits and security shutters. Key strengths are in-house production, full-spectrum frontage solutions and the innovative turnkey shop concept.

hightec.ch HighTec AG is a Swiss industrial engineering company founded in 1988 in Winterthur, specializing in turnkey surface treatment systems including painting booths, powder coating lines, air filtration and drying systems. With 50 to 100 employees, it designs, manufactures, installs and maintains coating solutions for automotive, aerospace, furniture and metal fabrication industries. Its product range covers dry filter and water wash booths, cartridge filter systems, ATEX explosion-proof solutions, electrostatic coating and energy-efficient drying ovens. The company emphasizes Swiss quality engineering with VOC compliance, waste heat recovery and digital monitoring. Key strengths are 38 years of experience, full turnkey delivery from concept to commissioning and ATEX-certified hazardous environment systems. It competes with Dürr and Nordson while offering personalized Swiss engineering and local European support.

pages.com.ve Pages Asociados C.A. is a Venezuelan engineering and consulting firm founded in 1972 in Caracas with over 52 years of experience in civil, structural, mechanical and electrical engineering. It operates its own geotechnical and materials testing laboratory, covering soil mechanics, concrete, asphalt and steel testing alongside field investigation services. With offices in Caracas, Maracaibo, Puerto Ordaz and Barinas, it serves the oil and gas, transport, energy and industrial sectors across Venezuela. Key projects include oil terminals for PDVSA, highways, bridges, hydropower plants and port infrastructure. Led by the Pages family across multiple generations, it employs around 200 to 500 engineers and technicians depending on project load. Key strengths are 52 years of market presence, in-house laboratory capabilities and full-service engineering from design through construction supervision and project management.
